title: Implement Levenshtein Edit Distance in Go
description: Implement EditDistance(s, t string) int returning the minimum edit operations (insert, delete, replace) to transform s into t using bottom-up DP.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement EditDistance in editdistance.go using bottom-up DP:
- Allocate dp[m+1][n+1]; set dp[i][0]=i and dp[0][j]=j
- For i=1..m, j=1..n: if s[i-1]==t[j-1], dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]; else dp[i][j]=1+min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1])
- Return dp[m][n]
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
